headline: The HRV gate fires and the gust hits 87 km/h - today is easy and indoors.
body:
The gate fires: HRV has sat under its own 14-day mean two mornings running - **65 then 63 against 69.1** - so today drops to easy.

The caveat: everything else disagrees. Resting heart rate is **42, the lowest in nineteen days**, and your body battery never fell below **57** yesterday, the highest low-point in that window, against 28-42 on every gym day. That is a body banking rest, not digging a hole. Take the easy read anyway.

The wind takes the rest: gusts run **80-87 km/h** in all three windows, so bike and open water read no. Wattbike 45-60 min at **126-140 bpm, cadence 85-95** - indoors reads 3-5 bpm high - or **2,000 m** at **2:00-2:10/100 m**. Nothing over 145 bpm.

Tomorrow 06:00-11:00 the gust drops to **25 km/h** and open water reads good for the first time since race day. That is where the sea swim goes; it shuts at 11:00.

Did you swim Thursday? No file, but your battery bottomed at 40. And the ankle? Tomorrow is the first clean run window since 13 September.
